visit_notes: Patient presents for follow-up regarding weight management therapy. Has been compliant with medication regimen for 8 weeks.
Current weight: 245 lbs, Height: 5'10". BMI calculated at 35.2 kg/m². Down from initial weight of 268 lbs.
Patient reports improved energy levels and decreased appetite. No significant adverse effects reported.
Comorbidities: Type 2 Diabetes (HbA1c 7.2%, improved from 8.1%), Hypertension (BP 138/85, on Lisinopril 10mg daily).
Patient has been attending dietitian visits bi-weekly for nutritional counseling and has started supervised exercise program (3x/week, 30 minutes each).
Weight loss progression: Week 1-2: 3 lbs, Week 3-4: 2.5 lbs, Week 5-8: 4 lbs. Total loss: 9.5 lbs over 8 weeks.
Family history significant for obesity and type 2 diabetes. Spouse also enrolled in weight management program.
Previous weight loss attempts documented: Tried low-carb diet (2019, lost 15 lbs, regained 22 lbs), Joined gym (2021, inconsistent attendance).
No contraindications to continued therapy. Patient expresses strong motivation to continue treatment.
Plan: Continue current regimen, increase to 10mg dose next visit if tolerating well, recheck labs in 3 months.
